topic: API data for average impressions in Brazil
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed a request regarding an API endpoint to retrieve average impression data for Brazil. It was confirmed that the functionality is already implemented, but questions arose concerning token transmission and location of the necessary code. [me] provided a sample `curl` command demonstrating how to pull data for all of Brazil at an hourly granularity using specific date ranges and duration arrays.

It was noted that while the API call structure was shared, pulling data for the entire country (Brazil) is not yet possible, as another team member is working on this feature.
decisions: A sample API query for hourly impression data across Brazil was provided.
action_items: Follow up on the Jira task mentioned by [p1].
Wait for further development regarding full Brazilian coverage via the API.
